name: What can I do to prevent future bathtub drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: What can I do to prevent future bathtub drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future bathtub drain clogs, regularly use a drain screen or hair catcher to keep hair and larger debris out of the drain. Avoid pouring grease, oil, or food scraps down the drain, as these can solidify and accumulate. Periodically flush your drain with hot water or a mixture of baking soda and vinegar to help break down soap scum and minor buildup. Consistent preventive measures can significantly reduce the frequency of clogs and the need for professional intervention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using drain screens, avoiding grease, and regularly flushing with hot water or baking soda and vinegar.
